# Getselfhelp.co.uk

> > Free, evidence-based CBT self-help resources including worksheets, videos, audio guides and therapeutic tools for mental health and psychological wellbeing.

Getselfhelp.co.uk (Get.gg) is a comprehensive mental health resource platform offering free CBT therapy materials, self-help guides, and downloadable worksheets for individuals and mental health professionals. The site provides evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy techniques alongside acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT) methods, mindfulness resources, and practical coping strategies for conditions like anxiety, depression, ADHD and OCD.

## Key Topics

- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy)
- Self-help resources
- Mental health
- Anxiety management
- Thought challenging
- STOPP technique
- ABCDE technique
- Mindfulness
- ADHD
- DBT
- Coping strategies
- Therapy worksheets
- Psychological techniques
- The Decider Skills

## Core Resources & Hubs

- [Homepage](https://getselfhelp.co.uk): Homepage for CBT therapy and self-help resources with free guides, worksheets, videos and MP3s
- [Self Help](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/self-help): Main self-help resources hub with CBT guides, solutions and therapeutic worksheets
- [Problems](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/problems): Index of mental health problems (ADHD, OCD, anxiety, depression) with CBT self-help guides
- [Solutions](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/solutions): CBT therapy techniques and solutions (STOPP, ABCDE, ACT) for mental health

## Downloads & Worksheets

- [Downloads](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/downloads): Free downloadable CBT worksheets, guides, leaflets and self-help resources
- [Free Downloads - CBT Information Leaflets & Self Help Guides](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/free-downloads-cbt-information-leaflets-self-help-guides): Free CBT information leaflets, self-help guides and printable therapy resources
- [Free Downloads - CBT Worksheets](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/free-downloads-2-cbt-worksheets): Free CBT worksheets, thought records, diaries and cognitive therapy logs
- [Document Packs](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/document-packs): Therapist document packs: CBT worksheets, formulations and self-help guides
- [Cards](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/cards): Downloadable 52-card pack of self-help techniques for mental health coping

## Audio & Video Learning

- [MP3s](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/mp3s): Audio downloads: guided relaxation, meditation, mindfulness and CBT-based MP3s
- [Videos](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/videos): CBT self-help videos covering anxiety, depression, stress and psychological techniques

## CBT Techniques & Methods

- [ABCDE Thought Challenging](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/abcde-thought-challenging): Guide to ABCDE thought-challenging technique for cognitive behavioral therapy
- [About Automatic Thoughts](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/about-automatic-thoughts): Educational guide on automatic thoughts and cognitive distortions in CBT
- [ACT: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/act-acceptance-commitment-therapy): Introduction to ACT therapy with mindfulness techniques and values-based living
- [Accept, Change or Let Go?](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/accept-change-or-let-go): Self-help framework for responding to thoughts and emotions with ACT principles
- [ACT: Accept, Choose, Take Action!](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/act-accept-choose-take-action): ACT self-help skill for acceptance, values-based choices and mental health action

## Specialized Resources

- [ACE Activity](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/ace-activity): ACE activity planning for achievement, connection and enjoyment in mental health
- [ADHD Self Help](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/adhd-self-help): Self-help strategies and coping techniques for ADHD and attention management
- [Cognitive Models & Formulations Reference](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/free-downloads-alphabetical-list-of-cognitive-models-formulations): Reference guide to CBT cognitive models, formulations and DBT frameworks

## For Mental Health Professionals

- [Professionals](https://getselfhelp.co.uk/professionals): Resources for therapists and mental health professionals using CBT worksheets
